concept: Describe your current mood or goal and AI matches you to a real Japanese calligraphy (shodo) phrase and brush-stroke style, with stroke-order guidance and the meaning/history behind the phrase.

Describe your personality or the person you're buying a gift for and AI matches them to one of Japan's traditional regional kokeshi doll styles (Naruko, Tsuchiyu, Yajiro, etc.), with the region's history and painting motifs explained.

Describe your current stress or mood and AI designs a matching karesansui (dry rock garden) layout from real traditional design principles, with an explanation of the raked-gravel pattern and rock arrangement chosen.
Describe a scene or feeling and AI matches it to a real ukiyo-e woodblock print and artist (Hokusai, Hiroshige, Utamaro, etc.), explaining why the print fits and the printmaking technique behind it.
